I told Marcus in his DM that his Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups go through Gate 35 on Juniper, and asked him to tell me if that's changed.

That answer comes from a note I saved from one of his own earlier DMs with me. His current DM with me holds only this question, so I couldn't check it against the original message.

I also have a saved note about another member's Thornbury dock. It's private to that member, so I left it out of my reply to him.
